subject: SIG intake & evidence grid — Aperture scheduling and owners
messages:
From: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@aperture-systems.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@aperture-systems.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake — availability and initial RFP

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for taking this. We kicked off our procurement review and the security team asked whether we can do a 45–60 minute SIG intake next week to go over the questionnaire scope and the evidence handoff. I attached our RFP PDF for context (Aperture_Security_RFP.pdf).

Top asks from my side:
- Walk through SIG sections we should prioritize for an initial pass (data flows, auth, logging)
- Evidence owners and expected formats (logs, runbooks, policies)
- Timeline for a completed SIG matrix for our procurement team

Availability: Tue/Wed afternoon PT or Fri morning PT. Prefer Tue if possible.

Best,
Daniel Ortiz
Director of IT Security | Aperture Systems
security@aperture-systems.com

P.S. We’ll need a single point of contact for evidence handoff and a CSV mapping of artifacts to SIG questions; happy to review a template in the call.

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@aperture-systems.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake — availability and initial RFP

Hi Daniel — thanks for the RFP and context. We can absolutely run a focused SIG intake and bring an evidence template. Proposed times:
- Tue 26 Jan, 1:00–2:00 PM PT
- Wed 27 Jan, 3:00–4:00 PM PT
- Fri 29 Jan, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Proposed agenda (45–60m):
1) 5m — Introductions & goals for the intake
2) 20m — SIG focus areas (you call out priorities; we highlight where Redwood has configuration choices)
3) 15m — Evidence handoff: formats, owners, and artifact examples (we’ll share a CSV template)
4) 10m — Timeline & next steps (deliverables and owners)

Action items for the call:
- We (Redwood) will provide: SIG-Aperture-Template.xlsx (SIG matrix + example answers), redwood-evidence-mapping-v1.csv (artifact->question), and a short runbook for log extraction samples.
- Aperture to provide: list of prioritized SIG sections and a preferred SFTP/Drive location for artifacts.

If Tue 1pm PT works I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the template.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment stubs: SIG-Aperture-Template.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-evidence-mapping-v1.csv (csv)

To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@aperture-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake — availability and initial RFP

> Proposed agenda (45–60m):
> 1) 5m — Introductions & goals for the intake
> 2) 20m — SIG focus areas (you call out priorities; we highlight where Redwood has configuration choices)
> 3) 15m — Evidence handoff: formats, owners, and artifact examples (we’ll share a CSV template)

Markus — I’ll lead the evidence mapping section and can show an example of how we map live logs and runbooks to specific SIG questions. Priyom will cover deployment isolation and data flow artifacts. Irene can speak to retention and audit logging exports.

Internal attendees (tentative):
- Markus Klein (SE) — primary SOW/contact for intake
- Olga Petrov (Security PM) — evidence mapping lead
- Priyom Das (Infra Eng) — deployment/dataflow artifacts
- Irene Choi (Compliance) — retention & audit logs

I’ll prepare a one-page intake checklist to share during the call. Markus — please send the invite for Tue 1pm PT if Daniel confirms.

Thanks,
Olga
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redwood-evidence-mapping-v1.csv (csv)

From: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@aperture-systems.com>
To: markus.klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@aperture-systems.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake — availability and initial RFP

Markus / Olga — Tue 1:00 PM PT works for our team. Calendar invite confirmed. Thank you for the clear agenda. A couple quick items before the call so we can prep on our end:

1) Evidence priority: please treat the following as high-priority: authentication (SSO + role mapping), network segmentation (VPC flow logs), and audit logging (retention + sample exports).
2) Artifact formats: CSV or ZIP with plain text logs are preferred. We can accept Draw.io or PDF diagrams for architecture.
3) Access: will Redwood be okay with uploading artifacts to a temporary Aperture S3 bucket? We’ll grant time-limited access; otherwise we can use a secure Drive link.

I attached the RFP earlier (Aperture_Security_RFP.pdf). We’ll also upload a small set of sample logs prior to the call to the Drive folder and share the link.

Looking forward — Daniel
Daniel Ortiz
Director of IT Security | Aperture Systems

----
Follow-up notes (to be filled after call):
- Confirmed evidence owners and target delivery dates
- Action: Redwood to populate SIG-Aperture-Template.xlsx and return within 5 business days
- Action: Aperture to upload sample logs to Drive and share access by EOD Tue
- Next meeting: SIG review (deep-dive) scheduled for two weeks post-intake

Attachments referenced: Aperture_Security_RFP.pdf, SIG-Aperture-Template.xlsx, redwood-evidence-mapping-v1.csv
